references.text: Complementary verses that together map out the original Horite chieftains in Edom before the Israelites arrived.
The retelling of the Horite genealogy in Chronicles confirms the history of the original inhabitants of Edom.
Completes the list of Seir's sons and confirms their role as the original chieftains in Edom.
Expands the genealogy of the chieftains Shobal and Zibeon mentioned in the source verse, showing their descendants.
